title: Importing data didn't display data and wiped settings
symptom: After wiping xDrip app data and cache, restoring settings and importing the exported database reports success, but no data is imported and the restored settings are wiped again. Repeating the import gives the same blank screen and cleared settings. Other users report the same on Android 11/12: the import says success but no data appears.
fix: Switch to the new Google Drive cloud backup methodology instead of the legacy zip import/export. On the old phone, create a Cloud Backup via the three-dots menu > Import/Export features > Cloud Backup. On the new phone, download that backup file, then in Cloud Backup > SELECT BACKUP LOCATION choose USE ALTERNATE FILE to select the downloaded file and tap RESTORE FROM BACKUP. One user also succeeded by restoring the zip on an older Android 8 phone, uploading it to Google Drive, and restoring from there on the Android 11 phone.
evidence_quote: The solution is to switch to the new backup methodology to Google Drive. That means when you buy a new phone, backup the database from the old phone using the new backup methodology, Google Drive Backup. Then, restore it on the new phone using the Google Drive Backup methodology. If you do that and it doesn't work, please let us know.
